items.title: El Salvador receives $138 million from IMF after Bitcoin waivers granted
items.summary: Efforts will continue to reduce the state’s involvement in Bitcoin-related activities and to strengthen crypto‑asset regulation and governance, the IMF said.

items.title: Hyperliquid’s USDC Yield Program Gets $14.6 Million for HYPE Buybacks
